content.text: Digital creators face significant challenges when trying to sell their products online due to restrictions imposed by conventional payment platforms like PayPal and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-honest-side-side-breakdown-20|stripe]]. In regions where these services are either unavailable or impose prohibitive fees, creators must find alternative solutions that allow them to retain more of their earnings. This is where no-KYC payment gateways, such as NOWPayments, can play a crucial role in facilitating seamless transactions for digital sales without the burdensome fees and requirements that major platforms impose.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-6. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

No-KYC payment gateways enable digital creators to sell their products directly to consumers without the need for extensive identity verification. This is particularly important in regions with high barriers to entry for traditional payment platforms. By leveraging cryptocurrencies, creators can avoid the high transaction fees associated with platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale. In contrast, NOWPayments only takes a 0.5% fee, allowing creators to keep more of their revenue. For example, if a creator sells 100 products priced at $97 each, the fee [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-stock-photos-without-paypal-honest-side-side-14|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-fonts-online-without-18|The Real]] translates into retaining an additional $921 per month, significantly impacting their bottom line.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind no-KYC payment gateways is designed to be both straightforward and effective. At its core, it utilizes blockchain technology to process transactions securely and transparently. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain and notifies the seller through a webhook. This process requires minimal infrastructure and can be integrated with platforms like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for automated delivery of digital products. The combination of these technologies ensures that creators have full control over their sales without the reliance on third-party platforms, enhancing their sovereignty.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is tailored for digital creators in regions such as Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and Venezuela, where traditional payment systems are often unreliable or inaccessible. These creators produce a variety of digital products, including ebooks, courses, and design templates, and require a reliable way to monetize their work. By adopting a no-KYC payment gateway, they can sell their products without the burden of platform fees or compliance headaches. This infrastructure empowers creators to focus on their craft while maintaining full ownership over their sales process and customer data.
Retain more of your earnings by avoiding high platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To effectively utilize a no-KYC payment gateway, several components must work in harmony. First, a hosting platform such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provides the necessary space to showcase products. Next, backend logic is managed through tools like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle order processing and delivery. For product storage and delivery, solutions such as Supabase or Google Drive are employed, ensuring that creators have the means to distribute their products seamlessly. Finally, integrating NOWPayments allows for efficient and low-cost payment processing, completing the infrastructure needed to sell digital products directly to consumers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start leveraging a no-KYC payment system, first choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages to display your products. Set up automated order processing using Google Apps Script, which will handle transactions and product delivery. Integrate NOWPayments to facilitate crypto transactions, ensuring you can accept payments without KYC requirements. Finally, utilize a storage solution such as Google Drive to host your digital products. This streamlined approach not only reduces costs but also empowers you to maintain complete control over your digital commerce operations.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a no-KYC payment gateway like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept cryptocurrency payments directly, eliminating the need for traditional payment processors while retaining more earnings. With minimal fees and no identity verification required, you can create a seamless purchasing experience for your customers.
Control your sales process with no third-party dependencies.

For those looking to establish a fully functional digital store without relying on conventional platforms, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all the necessary blueprints and templates to deploy your own sovereign commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore these resources.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online by using a no-KYC payment gateway like NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This enables you to accept payments directly from customers without relying on traditional platforms.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

Utilizing a combination of GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing allows you to sell digital downloads with minimal fees, retaining more of your earnings compared to platforms like Gumroad.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, by deploying your own digital commerce stack using no-KYC payment gateways, you can sell templates and fonts directly to customers without the restrictions and fees associated with platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What are the advantages of using a no-KYC payment gateway?

The main advantages include lower transaction fees, no identity verification requirements, and complete control over your sales process. This allows for greater financial sovereignty and a more profitable business model.
How do I ensure secure digital product delivery?

To ensure secure delivery, utilize automated scripts that handle order fulfillment and integrate with a reliable file storage solution. This guarantees that customers receive their purchases promptly and securely.
